reviews.x: Purchased the white eye masks for give always and Christmas packages but the wording on the front of the packaging was nonsensical English unlike the picture in the listing.

When stressing over the state of the world keeps you up all night, or homeschooling your children reduces you to a quivering puddle of tears, these bad boys help to de-puff your eyes and reduce the dark circles.

I’m a big fan of these little under eye mask but I’m always skeptical about which ones to get because I have very sensitive skin. I took a gamble because the price was good and it came it so many. Luckily for me the gamble paid off! They work so well, my eyes don’t get irritated from them, and I could tell a difference in about a week or two. I would highly recommend these.

reviews.t: Don’t buy unless you don’t care
reviews.x: I’m not really comfortable putting these on my face because the words on the packaging does not make sense and is definitely not English. I did not try the product because I’m uncomfortable with the packaging. Don’t buy unless you don’t care

So I had to stop doing my makeup this morning to come type this review. I will finish my makeup before posting this review so I can add a picture. Lol  I am a real person who bought these wonderful under eye pads. I haven’t been paid to review them nor have I been offered anything for free for this review. This is an honest review.  With all of that out of the way… WOW!!! So, I’m in my 40’s, and I’ve been fighting the dark circles and puffy eyes for a little while now. Here lately, I’ve been los

I like the thickness of these eye masks but other than that, I don’t feel like they do anything. The strips don’t feel super “wet” and I feel like I’m not getting a lot of product when I apply. I also don’t see a drop in puffy under-eyes or much relief other than a cooling sensation. While they’re not unpleasant, there are better options on the market. There’s also typo’s on the packaging.
Great eye pads for the days your puffy.  Pop them in the fridge and in the morning put them on for a nice treat

I've already bought another set of these.  I have been using them everyday now for the last 2 weeks. I start to see a difference.  I put them in the fridge to keep them cold and pull them out one at time when I need them.  I use one at bed time.  Plus, you can't be the price for these eye gel pads.  Why pay more for the expensives ones when they all work pretty much the exactly the same.  Save your money and buy these one instead.

These came nicely packaged and they actually stay on my face. They make my skin feel really soft after. I'm hoping to see some other improvements with continued use. I would recommend you atleast give these a try. Not a bad price either for the amount that you get.

reviews.t: First Try I saw a difference! Wow.
reviews.x: This stuff works! I’ve been sleeping only 4-5 hours since my spine surgery and started to notice dark circles. I tried this for the First time today! And look! My skin looks 2 tones! It really brighten up my eye! Buy this!!!

reviews.t: Hey, these under eye patches really work!
reviews.x: I am a mature man, and have been looking for a product to keep me looking young(er) and fresh. After trying various products I stumbled on these under eye patches and they're amazing. They really work just like the product description says. Sometimes I use them after a night of partying with friends and I look fresh and rested. I don't know whether they'll work for you as well as they work for me, but they're so cheap you should give them a try. Tip: on the directions it says to not leave them o

Bought based on reviews and will continue to use up the supply.  They are a little difficult to put in place but do go on OK if you work with them.  But I have seen 0 effect from their use.  I wear them per instructions and want to be objective in their evaluation but thus far after 10 or so uses,  cannot see any positive results.

I let these sit on my under eyes til they're dry and shriveled up. I do see a small difference and a few uses. They're very cooling and refreshing. I even take some of what's left in the package and put that under my eyes.
I put them in the fridge so they’re cold to reduce puffiness
Took my puffiness  away.  I use each  night . LOVE ❤️

Bought these for a fun mask to do for bachelorette sleepover party. These are not like any of the original gold collagen masks. They feel like fat slugs coming out of the package, did not mold the eye area and, worse of all, they burned and caused rashes within seconds of putting them on. All but 1 person out of 12 didn't have edema and reddening of the under eyes. We pulled them off immediately and washed the goop off.

I love these eye masks.. When I tell you they are a mini miracle, I’m not joking. I normally wake up with puffy swollen eyes and after about 30mins with my Gold strips on, I be ready to claim that I woke up like this.. If you struggle with puffy swollen eyes like myself, invest in these Gold “Miracle” Strips.. It’s soooooo worth it!!!!

Love these little eye pads.  I use them almost every AM for puffy eyes.  I put them on just as soon as I get up.  By the time I get in shower, the puff is almost gone (depending on how much fun I had the night before).  Actually, I am giving them for little "favors"  & my students seem to love them.

reviews.t: Felt like a spa treatment for under my eyes
reviews.x: I gave these as part of a stocking stuffer for coworkers plus kept several for myself. I was really impressed with them. Felt so cool and soothing under my eyes while wearing the masks. Definitely noticed less puffiness and darkness under the eyes that seemed to last a day or two.
Put  on as I’m getting ready in the morning for my daily beauty routine. They are nice ,refreshing and help take the bags under my eyes away. Would recommend them
I love the individual packaging that's easy to use. You just open one of these up and place is right underneath your eye!
Burned under my eyes after third use. Too bad because they hydrate well.

reviews.t: They don’t stay on the skin very well.
reviews.x: Not great. Don’t stay on skin very well.

No issues so far. There’s not a huge difference when I wear these. However I do see a slight improvement if I am sick or tired and wear these before heading out. Honestly, I think I would purchase a different brand since I can’t see the difference. I gifted the rest of the pack as Christmas presents, which was nice.

I’m not sure this is working for me. I’m an African American female and I still see the dark circles I have also broken out under my left eye since using this product clear skin before so this is a little embarrassing for me hoping it will go away soon

claims.text: Many reviewers find the eye masks cooling and effective at reducing puffiness and dark circles.
Several reviewers praise the value and quantity for the price.
Some reviewers report the product had little to no effect on their under-eyes.
A few reviewers complain that the packaging wording is nonsensical or not English.
Some reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and find the masks comfortable to wear.
